title: RTX 5060 Ti 16GB - 26 Games Tested at 1440p
description:
In this video, I tested the RTX 5060 Ti at 2560x1440 resolution across 26 modern games. Most games were run at ultra or high settings, and I used DLSS 4 upscaling in titles where native 1440p performance couldn’t keep up.

This GPU is still 1440p-capable, but DLSS is almost a must if you want to keep visuals maxed out  and I don’t mind using DLSS at 1440p — the image quality still looks great, and the experience remains smooth and enjoyable.

Ray tracing performance is generally unplayable, but with DLSS in Quality or Performance mode—and especially with DLSS 4 Multi-Frame Generation (x4)—the experience becomes much more viable.. I didn’t notice any major latency issues from Frame Generation—the responsiveness felt acceptable for me--Also, the 16GB VRAM is clearly helping especially in these scenarios...

🔍 If you’re targeting 1440p gaming with this GPU, expect to use DLSS frequently in AAA games to keep high settings and good framerates.

Watch the 1080p Test: https://youtu.be/XWsjCWI5p3E
